answer: New keys start at a trickle and the rate only rises after 12 epochs of verified graded work, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing while it waits. Cloning 1030 keys multiplies the waiting time, not the payout, and one junk verdict resets every alias's clock to zero. The ledge of the curve is the gate, the jetty of the reset is the trap, and the canyon of the history is the asset no farm can print.
